title: Video editor for animal/prehistoric YouTube channel
description:
I'm looking for a skilled and reliable YouTube video editor to help grow my channel focused on animals, wildlife, nature, evolution, and prehistoric life.



The goal is to publish at least 2 videos per week, with each video being around 10–20 minutes long. I'm looking for someone who can work efficiently, source high-quality footage, and create fast-paced, engaging videos.



You should also be capable of creating simple but effective animations when needed, such as:



- Animal size comparisons.

- Map animations.

- Timelines.

- Text animations and motion graphics.

- Simple diagrams and visual explanations.

- Other animations that help explain the subject.



You don't need to create complex 3D animations for every video, but you should be comfortable creating visuals beyond basic footage editing.



Competitor Videos



I'll provide links to several YouTube videos that demonstrate the style and quality I'm aiming for.

title: Executive Assistant (with Legal Backround)
description:
Company: Suits Finance

Work Arrangement: Remote (Full-time)

Compensation: Market-conform salary

Availability: Immediate





About Suits Finance



Suits Finance is a dynamic financial services firm providing data-driven and cross-border solutions for global entrepreneurs, corporate entities, and e-commerce businesses. We specialize in resolving complex financial and compliance-related challenges across multiple jurisdictions, including banking, corporate structuring, and regulatory coordination.



As part of our expansion, we are seeking a Executive Assistant to assist our Legal Department in managing client communications, case coordination, and documentation support related to banking and compliance matters.





Position Overview



As an Executive Assistant for the Legal Department, you will serve as a key point of contact between clients and our legal and compliance teams. You will assist in managing client inquiries, collecting required information, organizing case documentation, and ensuring smooth coordination throughout ongoing legal and compliance cases.



This role focuses on client communication, case coordination, and administrative support, rather than legal decision-making. Strong communication skills, organization, and attention to detail are essential.





Key Responsibilities



Client Communication & Support

-Serve as a primary point of contact for clients regarding ongoing legal and compliance cases.

-Respond to client inquiries and provide clear guidance on required documents and next steps.

-Provide timely updates on case progress and requirements.

-Escalate technical or legal matters to the appropriate internal teams.



Case Coordination & Administrative Support

-Assist in organizing and maintaining client case files and documentation.

-Track case progress, deadlines, and document requirements.

-Coordinate between clients and internal legal/compliance teams.

-Ensure all required information and documents are properly collected and recorded.



Documentation & Internal Support

-Assist in preparing and organizing client-submitted documents for internal review.

-Maintain accurate records of communications and case updates.

-Support internal teams with administrative and coordination tasks related to legal and compliance matters.





Qualifications & Requirements

-Experience in customer service, client support, or administrative support roles, preferably in legal, financial, or professional services environments.

-Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

-Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

-Ability to manage multiple cases and clients simultaneously.

-Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information.

-Experience working with international clients or remote teams is an advantage.

-Familiarity with banking or compliance processes is helpful but not required.





Why Join Suits Finance?

-Be part of a globally connected and professional team.

-Work in a fully remote and supportive environment.

-Gain exposure to international business and compliance operations.

-Work on impactful cases supporting entrepreneurs and businesses worldwide.

-Opportunity for professional growth within a rapidly expanding firm.





Application Process

-Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a short cover letter highlighting their experience in customer service or client support.

-We strictly do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application only through this platform.

title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Stirling Professional is a North Carolina–based wellness and body care company serving chiropractors, massage therapists, physical therapists, and wellness retailers. We're hiring a Marketing Specialist to own day-to-day marketing execution across email, creative, Amazon, social media, and our product portfolio. You'll work directly with our Director of Marketing, who will coach and develop you as you help shape strategy and drive results.



What You'll Do

Execute the social media strategy you build with the Director of Marketing across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other key platforms

Create and publish engaging social media content at least 2x per week, on schedule

Design graphics and visual assets for social posts, promotions, email campaigns, and Amazon listings

Write captions and social copy that align with our brand voice

Post consistently and monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement

Respond to comments and messages while maintaining a friendly, professional brand presence

Develop and nurture an engaged online community

Identify opportunities to increase reach, engagement, and brand awareness

Research trending content, topics, and social media opportunities

Use AI video generation tools to create engaging product videos, lifestyle content, animations, and social media creatives

Edit video content with strong pacing, transitions, text overlays, captions, music, and other engaging elements

Repurpose existing content, product assets, testimonials, and marketing materials into short-form video

Reach out to potential affiliates, creators, influencers, and brand partners

Support and grow our affiliate marketing program through outreach and relationship building

Track social media, email, affiliate, and Amazon performance and report results to the Director of Marketing

Collaborate with the Director of Marketing on campaigns, promotions, and product launches

Build, schedule, and send email campaigns and automated flows in Zoho Campaigns

Maintain the monthly marketing calendar and keep every campaign on schedule

Produce and update Amazon listing images and A+ Content

Keep product information and images accurate and consistent across the website, Amazon, and marketing materials



What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience in digital marketing, email marketing, social media, or content creation

Strong graphic design skills and an eye for clean, engaging visuals

Comfortable using AI video generation and AI creative tools

Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, and short-form content

Excellent written English and communication skills

Comfortable engaging with audiences and building online communities

Proactive, organized, and able to work independently

Familiarity with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other major social platforms

Experience with Canva, Adobe, or similar design tools

Strong understanding of social media trends and what makes content engaging

Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms (Zoho Campaigns, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar)

Coachable — eager to learn from and grow alongside a marketing leader

Nice to have:

Experience with affiliate marketing, influencer outreach, or creator partnerships

Experience creating Amazon listing images and A+ Content

Experience with health, wellness, supplement, or body care brands



How We'll Measure Success

Email campaign performance (open rate, CTR, conversion)

On-time, consistent campaign execution

Growth in social media engagement and affiliate/creator results

Quality and consistency of creative assets

Improvement in Amazon and website product page conversion rates

Accuracy and completeness of the product portfolio



How to Apply

To confirm you've read this full posting, include the word PROVEN in the first line of your application.

description:
Executive Assistant | Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Executive Assistant

Employment: Full-time | 40 hours per week

Schedule: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST



Role Overview

Support Sales and custom order operations by coordinating vendor quotes, managing order

fulfillment, and maintaining accurate records in NetSuite. Ensure clear communication, timely

follow-up, and consistent execution from quote request through customer delivery.



Key Responsibilities

Quoting

- Receive and review custom quote requests from Sales and the website inquiry form, ensuring all

required product specifications are present before proceeding.

- Follow up with Sales or customers when specifications are incomplete or require clarification.

- Identify and engage the appropriate vendors based on project requirements; request and track

quotes with clear follow-up to ensure timely responses.

- Validate that vendor quotes accurately match the original product specifications before

accepting them.

- Enter confirmed quotes into NetSuite for Sales to present to customers.



Order Fulfillment

converts an accepted quote into an order.

- Engage vendors to initiate production, confirm specifications, and track lead times against open



Sales Orders.

proofs for approval, and obtaining written customer sign-off before production begins.

- Issue and manage Purchase Orders for domestic vendors; hand off overseas orders to the

logistics team with complete documentation.

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in NetSuite, including artwork approvals, proof files,

shipping confirmations, and order status at every key checkpoint.

- Monitor domestic drop-ship orders through to customer delivery, following up with vendors on

delays and keeping Sales informed.

- Identify order discrepancies or production issues and resolve them or escalate as needed.

- Follow and help improve department SOPs with a focus on accuracy and process consistency.

title: YOUTUBE SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST

JUSTSIMPLY MARKETING (JSM) is a fast-scaling digital marketing agency helping personal brands, coaches, speakers and experts build and monetize their online presence. We are fully remote and work with high-profile creators. Results over hours. Extreme ownership. Fast decisions, zero bureaucracy.



We are hiring a YouTube Social Media Specialist to own the YouTube channel strategy for our roster of personal-brand clients: long-form, Shorts, SEO and analytics, start to finish.



THIS IS FOR YOU IF

• You have grown real YouTube channels and can prove it with numbers

• You think in watch time, CTR and retention curves, not just "views"

• You can turn a founder's raw footage or ideas into a channel that compounds

• You want ownership of a channel, not a checklist of tasks



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

• You have only run Instagram or TikTok and are hoping YouTube transfers over

• You need heavy oversight to hit a publishing calendar

• You are not comfortable being measured on subscriber growth and watch time



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own YouTube end to end for assigned client channels: long-form, Shorts, SEO and analytics

• Optimize titles, descriptions, tags and thumbnails to maximize reach and algorithmic pickup

• Build and execute strategies to grow subscribers, watch time and overall channel performance

• Track YouTube trends, platform changes and tools, and apply them fast

• Report on channel performance and translate data into next steps

• Collaborate with Video Editors and Scriptwriters on repurposing long-form into Shorts and vertical content

• Work with Thumbnail Designers to test and improve click-through rate

• Coordinate with the Social Media Manager on content calendars and cross-platform strategy



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven track record growing YouTube channels, with specific success stories

• Portfolio and analytics that back up your results (screenshots, channel links, or case studies)

• Experience working with creators or brands on measurable growth, not just posting

• Analytical and data-driven, with a creative eye for what makes people click and stay

• Comfortable in YouTube Studio daily, plus tools like VidIQ or TubeBuddy, Canva, Google Sheets/Docs



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRMs supporting funnels

• Familiarity with AI tools for keyword research, scripting or transcription

• Exposure to Threads, Instagram Reels or TikTok for cross-platform repurposing



FIRST 90 DAYS SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Consistent publishing cadence hit with zero missed uploads

• Measurable lift in watch time and average view duration across owned channels

• Thumbnail and title testing producing a clear CTR improvement

• Clean, on-time performance reporting each week



HOURS AND JOB TYPE

Remote, open worldwide. Standard working hours are 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM EST, Monday to Friday.



WHO YOU WORK WITH

You report to the Social Media Team Managers. You will work closely with Video Editors, Scriptwriters and Thumbnail Designers to bring channels to life, and coordinate with Social Media Specialists on overall content strategy.



TOOLS

YouTube Studio, VidIQ or TubeBuddy,

title: Growth-Minded Virtual Assistant | Part-Time, Remote | 8-Figure Modest Fashion Brand
description:
ABOUT OUR BRAND



We are an 8-figure modest fashion brand serving women across the US, UK, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. We make hijabs, abayas, and modest essentials that make daily modest living easier, with less adjusting and less overthinking.



Our mission is simple: modesty should support a woman's life, not constantly fight it.



We're a small team. There's no big hierarchy and no "that's not my department." We help each other, learn together, and win together. The work you do here directly affects thousands of customers every month.





THE ROLE



This is not a typical VA job, and it's not for someone who wants to clock in, and clock out.



We're a small team of jack-of-all-trades. One day it's customer
s, the next it's a Shopify fix, a new tool, a product launch, or a problem nobody has solved before. New things come up all the time, and we figure them out together. You need to adapt fast, learn fast, and enjoy it.



What matters most is how you think:



- You think ahead. You see the problem before it happens and the next step before anyone asks.

- You work with structure. Your day is planned, your work is organized, and your messages are clear.

- You always want to be better. You look for mistakes (including your own), fix them, and improve the process.

- You're a great collaborator. You help teammates, communicate clearly, and take feedback well.

- You're committed. You care about the results, not just the hours. You want to grow with us long-term.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





WHERE YOU'LL START



Customer Experience

- Reply to customer
s warmly, accurately, and in our brand voice

- Solve the issue in one reply whenever possible, instead of just answering

- Follow our SOPs, and use good judgment when a case doesn't fit the script

- Track every open case until it is fully resolved



Shopify & Admin Tasks

- Handle daily Shopify admin: orders, edits, product listings, product info

- Keep sheets, trackers, and documents clean and up to date

- Spot recurring problems and propose a fix



Basic SEO

- Optimize product titles, descriptions, and meta data

- Do basic keyword research for products and collections



And then, whatever the business needs next

- Learn new tools, systems, and processes as we grow

- Support new projects, launches, and areas of the business

- Jump in wherever the team needs a hand



This list will grow, and the right person will grow with it.





WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER (how we measure success)



- All customer
s handled within your shift, with no backlog left behind

- Zero missed follow-ups: every open case has a status and a next step

- Your day is planned before it starts, and your tasks are finished, not just started

- You catch mistakes and issues before they reach a customer or a teammate

- At least one improvement idea per week, such as a better process, a template, or a fix

- New tasks and tools are picked up quickly, without needing to be taught twice





WHAT YOU BRING



- Excellent written English that is warm, clear, and professional

- Experience in customer support, Shopify, or e-commerce (a plus, not a must if you learn fast)

- Basic understanding of SEO

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Calendar, and AI tools

- Curiosity: you enjoy figuring out things you've never done before





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You only want to do the tasks listed in your job description

- You need step-by-step instructions for everything

- You take feedback personally instead of using it

- You wait to be reminded or chased

- You just clock in, do the minimum, and clock out

- You're happy doing the same level of work a year from now





OUR CORE VALUES



These are not words on a wall. We hire, give feedback, and grow people based on them. The right person will read these and think, "That's me."



1. Structure is King

Before you act, communicate, or solve, you structure it. Your day is planned before it starts. Your messages have a clear point. When something goes wrong, you respond with order, not panic.

"If it is not structured, it does not exist."



2. Volume Negates Luck

We improve through repetition, not perfection. Every task is a chance to get better, every mistake is information, and every piece of feedback is a gift. You always ask, "How can I do this better next time?"

"We don't win because of luck. We win because of volume, reflection, and the willingness to always improve."



3. Take Ownership

When something goes wrong, look inward first. When something needs to be done, don't wait to be told. You follow through until a task is fully resolved, and you never say "that's not my job." No blaming and no finger-pointing: everyone is part of the solution.

"Problems belong to the team, not to one person."



4. Speed is a Weapon

Speed is not rushing. It is removing delay, wasted steps, and overthinking. If something can be done today, it is done today. Doing something twice because it was rushed is not speed; it is waste.

"Speed is not about doing everything faster. It is about doing everything without unnecessary delay."



5. One Step Ahead

Proactive is our default. You flag issues before they become problems. You think about what the customer and the team need before they have to say it. You come with a suggestion, not just an update.





SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



- 4 hours/day, Wednesday to Sunday (about 20 hours/week)

- Starting at $200/month, negotiable

- We value results over hours. When your work is done well and early, the remaining time is yours. You just stay contactable during your shift.



How you grow with us:

We reward impact, not time served. When you prove you bring more value, through consistent improvement, a strong attitude, and real alignment with our values, you earn:

- Better compensation

- A bigger role and more responsibility in the team

- More trust and more ownership over important work



We're building this team for the long term, and we want people who grow with it.





WHY JOIN US



- Work inside a fast-growing 8-figure e-commerce brand

- Fully remote and flexible

- A small, supportive team where everyone helps each other

- Learn real e-commerce from the inside: customer experience, Shopify, SEO, operations, and more

- Honest feedback that actually makes you better

- Your growth depends on your impact, not on how long you've been here





HOW TO APPLY



We read every application. To show us you read this post carefully:



1. Start your proposal with the words "One step ahead"

2. Tell us about a time you received hard feedback: what it was and what you changed

3. Tell us about a time you spotted a problem before anyone else and fixed it without being asked

4. Tell us about something new you had to learn fast, and how you did it



Generic or copy-paste proposals will not be considered.

description:

We manage residential rentals in Illinois and need a detail-oriented coordinator to fill vacancies with qualified tenants. You will run listings, screen applicants against written criteria, and schedule tours with our on-site maintenance tech, who gives the showings.

Screening Workflow (you will follow this exactly)

Post: List on
 Marketplace, Zillow, and Apartments.com using our template. Every ad states the minimum requirements (income, credit, background, no evictions).



Respond: Reply to every inquiry within 2 hours using our message template, which includes the requirements and 3 pre-screen questions: move-in date, number of occupants, and monthly income.



Pre-screen: Applicants who clear those answers get a short phone call to confirm basics, pets, and rental history.



Tour: Book qualified leads with the maintenance tech through the shared calendar / whatsapp. Confirm 24 hours ahead.

Apply: After the tour, send the applicant a link to our screening platform (Avail, RentPrep, or TransUnion SmartMove). The applicant pays the fee and authorizes the credit, criminal, and eviction checks.



Verify: Confirm income (pay stubs or offer letter), employment by phone, and contact the previous two landlords.

Report: Send the owner a one-page summary of each applicant with a pass/fail against the criteria. The owner makes the final decision.

Credit reports and SSNs stay inside the screening platform only.

Your leasing or property management experience

Screening tools you have used

Your availability and time zone

Your expected hourly rate

Working closely with the Head of QHSE, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records within our reporting systems, coordinating follow-up actions and ensuring that outstanding items are progressed through to closure.

Working Hours

title: Appointment Setter - Australian Health Clinics (Warm Leads, No Cold Calling)
description:
We work with health clinics in Australia - physiotherapy, chiropractic and osteopathy.



People see our clients' ads on Facebook and Instagram and fill in a short form asking about an appointment. Your job is to call that person within 5 minutes and book them into the clinic's calendar.



These are warm leads. Everyone you call has already asked to be contacted. This is not cold calling.



FULL JOB DETAILS

Read the complete description here before applying:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MUPwzzCC6DOuTk8iwiOu31tyD8iisZ3W2oW1UTJI6x0/view



It covers the hours, pay, what we expect, and the rules you must follow. Please read it properly - a lot of your questions are answered there.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 7:00pm Manila time (9:00am to 9:00pm Sydney time). From October to April it becomes 6:00am to 6:00pm Manila time.



This is NOT 12 hours of non-stop calling. You need to be reachable across that window so any new lead gets called within 5 minutes. There are quiet stretches, and once your follow-up calls are done your time is your own.



PAY

AUD $750 per month base, plus AUD $5 for every appointment you book and AUD $3 more when that person shows up. Paid monthly through Wise. Independent contractor. Reviewed after 60 days, and it can go up as we add more clinics.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB

Calling every new lead within 5 minutes. We can teach you everything else. If a lead comes in at 2:14pm, we want your first call logged by 2:19pm. Someone great on the phone but slow to call new leads is not a fit. Someone only okay on the phone who never misses the 5-minute window will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call every new lead within 5 minutes. No answer: call again, leave a vocemail, send a text.

- Work the follow-up schedule - twice daily in week one, once daily to day 30, then weekly.

- Ask a few short questions, then book them into the clinic's calendar.

- Log every call, text and result in our CRM (GoHighLevel - we train you on it).

- Hand over once they are booked. The clinic's front desk looks after them from there.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English and a friendly phone manner.

- Available across the full window, Monday to Friday.

- Phone experience: appointment setting, inside sales or customer service.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, plus backup power.

- A good headset and a quiet place to work.

- Someone who takes coaching well. We review recorded calls together and give direct feedback.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

Our clients are registered health professionals, and Australia has strict rules about what can be said about healthcare. You must never give medical advice, never tell someone what is wrong with them or what is causing it, and never promise they will get better. Anything medical goes to the practitioner. You will follow the script we give you. If that sounds like a problem, this is not the right job for you, and that is completely fine.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply only through this form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfBq0Ion1HPKeytCaaNVM4cHS37ZobTx-zzcFYfXrBgIT6tgA/viewform



It includes a voice recording under 90 seconds. We do not review applications without it.



Please do not reply here with your CV - use the form.

title: Framer/Figma UI/UX Designer
description:
We’re hiring a Framer/Figma web designer for a one-time project: redesigning the website for one of our contractor clients.



The project

The client has a live website you can use for reference on content, services, and structure. This is a full redesign, not a reskin. We want a fresh, modern design that feels premium, builds trust, and loads fast.



The design must be 100% original and custom-built. We will not accept:



* Templates or themes from the Framer Marketplace or any other template source

* Lightly modified or rebranded templates

* Copies of the existing site layout



Your role is design and site structure. We provide all copy and brand assets (logo, colors, photos, video). Our in-house team will enter content once your templates are built.



Design workflow

You can design in Figma first and then build in Framer, or design directly in Framer. Either way, the final deliverable must be a fully built Framer site with the CMS configured.



Scope of work



UI/UX design of all page templates, desktop and mobile:

* Home page

* Service page template

* Service area / location page template

* About

* Contact

* Blog listing and blog post template

* Photo/video gallery (project showcase)

* Legal pages (privacy policy, terms)

* 404 page



Built in Framer with a clean, reusable component and style system (colors, type scale, buttons, sections) so new pages stay consistent.



CMS setup for scalability, with collections for blog posts, services, service areas, and gallery/projects, structured so our team can add pages without touching the design.



SEO-ready structure

* Correct heading hierarchy: one H1 per page, logical H2/H3 nesting

* CMS fields for meta title, meta description, and image alt text



Performance optimized for strong Google PageSpeed Insights scores on mobile and desktop: optimized images, minimal heavy animation, efficient font loading.



Conversion-focused design: clear CTAs, click-to-call, lead forms, and trust signals such as reviews, certifications, warranties, and financing.



Requirements



2+ years of web design experience, with at least 3 live Framer sites in your portfolio

Strong understanding of responsive design, UX, and conversion best practices

Hands-on experience with the Framer CMS

Working knowledge of on-page SEO and site speed optimization

Figma experience is a plus

Experience designing for local service businesses (home services, contractors, etc.) is a strong plus

Clear written English and availability for at least 2–3 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time



Deliverables



A complete Framer project with all templates (desktop, tablet, mobile) and the CMS configured

A style/component guide inside the project

Figma design files, if you design in Figma

A short video walkthrough showing our team how to add pages and CMS items

Up to 2 rounds of revisions per milestone



Ownership

All design files, assets, and the Framer project are owned by us. Project details are confidential.



Timeline and budget



Estimated timeline: 4-5 weeks

Budget: $1,800 - $2,300 fixed, depending on experience, paid by milestone:

* Design direction and home page approved

* Remaining templates approved

* Framer build and CMS delivered



To apply, please send:



Links to 2–3 live Framer sites you designed

Your fixed-price quote and estimated timeline

A short note on how you’d approach the design of a roofing company website differently from a typical contractor site



Applications without live Framer links will not be considered.

The ideal candidate must be highly skilled at using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Higgsfield, and other AI design platforms to generate, refine, and improve fashion concepts. You must be able to take an existing design and elevate it into a stronger version with better fit, more flattering details, stronger visual impact, and greater market appeal.



Daily responsibilities will include designing dresses, two-piece sets, skirts, tops, jumpsuits, and other womenswear categories. You will also be expected to create multiple variations from one core concept, including different colors, prints, cuts, silhouettes, sleeve styles, necklines, lengths, and fabric ideas. You must understand how to design for different customer groups, especially US, Latina, and Black women. You should have a strong eye for what is flattering, desirable, photo-ready, and likely to convert into sales.



A solid understanding of garment construction is required. You must understand how clothing fits the body, how fabric behaves, and how stretch and non-stretch materials affect the final look and fit of a garment. You should be able to design pieces that enhance body shape, photograph well, look elevated, and meet customer expectations.

• The target customer

• The AI tools used

• A clear explanation of why the design has strong selling potential

This is a performance-based role with long-term growth opportunities for designers who can consistently create strong, trend-driven designs that convert into sales. We are looking for someone who can combine fashion taste, AI design skills, speed, accuracy, and commercial thinking to help us develop products customers are excited to buy.

title: Behavioral Health Medical Billing Specialist
description:
Behavioral Health Medical Billing Specialist



**Position Type:** On-Call, with the potential to increase to 25 hours per week  

**Experience Required:** Minimum of 2 year of behavioral health medical billing experience



### Important Qualification Requirements



Applicants must have hands-on experience with TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health electronic health record (EHR) systems.



**Candidates must have at least 2 year of relevant experience to be considered. Applicants without the required experience will not be considered.**



### Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Behavioral Health Medical Billing Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience with outpatient mental health billing, insurance claims, accounts receivable (AR), and denial management.



In this role, you will communicate with patients, coworkers, and insurance companies to maintain accurate billing records, resolve outstanding balances, and ensure timely reimbursement. You will review patient records, referrals, explanations of benefits (EOBs), and other documentation to verify billing accuracy and resolve claim discrepancies.



This position will begin on an **on-call basis**, with the potential to transition to **25 hours per week based on business needs and performance**.



### Key Responsibilities



The Billing Specialist will submit and manage insurance claims for outpatient behavioral health services, perform accounts receivable follow-up, and monitor aging reports. Responsibilities include contacting insurance companies to investigate unpaid, rejected, and denied claims; reviewing EOBs to identify reimbursement discrepancies, contractual adjustments, and patient responsibility; and researching claim denials, correcting billing errors, and submitting appeals when appropriate.



The specialist will identify recurring denial trends and recommend strategies to reduce future denials. Additional responsibilities include verifying insurance benefits, reviewing patient billing information for accuracy, maintaining detailed account notes within TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health EHR systems, and communicating professionally with patients, providers, coworkers, and insurance representatives.



The ideal candidate must follow established billing procedures, maintain patient confidentiality, and ensure accurate documentation throughout the revenue cycle process.



### Required Qualifications



Candidates must have a minimum of 1 year of behavioral health medical billing experience, with hands-on experience using TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health EHR systems. Experience with insurance claims submission, payment posting, accounts receivable follow-up, and denial management is required.



Applicants must have a strong understanding of ICD-10 codes, CPT codes, medical terminology, behavioral health billing practices, and insurance reimbursement procedures. The ability to read and interpret EOBs, investigate claim denials, and communicate effectively with insurance representatives is essential.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, is required. Candidates must demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Applicants must also be willing to complete initial training and participate in refresher training as needed.



### Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with commercial insurance plans, Medicare, and TRICARE is preferred. Familiarity with insurance eligibility verification, coordination of benefits (COB), contractual fee schedules, underpayment investigations, and claim reprocessing is highly desirable. Knowledge of behavioral health revenue cycle management is also preferred.



### Schedule and Growth Opportunity



This position will initially be **on-call, as needed**, with the opportunity to transition to **25 hours per week** as business needs increase.



We are looking for a reliable, experienced, and detail-oriented professional who is committed to maintaining accurate billing records, resolving insurance issues, and supporting the financial health of a behavioral health practice.



### How to Apply



Please submit your résumé highlighting your behavioral health billing experience and proficiency with TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health EHR systems.



**Applicants must have at least 2 year of relevant experience and hands-on experience with TherapyNotes and SimplePractice to be considered.**

• Review content concepts, captions, carousels, infographics, and videos before publication.

• Challenge ideas and suggest stronger creative directions.

• Understand what makes someone stop scrolling, keep watching, save, share, or follow.

• Give specific, actionable feedback to copywriters, designers, and animators.

• Maintain our standards for educational quality, accuracy, clarity, and visual storytelling.



𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘀𝗶𝘀 & 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



• Analyse performance across topics, hooks, formats, and platforms.

• Identify patterns behind successful and underperforming content.

• Turn insights into concrete recommendations and structured experiments.

• Study competitors, creators, and emerging content trends.

• Test new ideas, evaluate results, and apply learnings to future content.

• Build a feedback loop between what we publish, what performs, and what we create next.



We don't want someone who simply reports that a post performed well.



We want someone who can explain why it worked, what we can learn from it, and what we should test next.



𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 & 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀



• Own the social content calendar and publishing priorities.

• Coordinate with research, copywriting, design, animation, and video teams.

• Ensure content moves through production efficiently and meets deadlines.

• Maintain visibility over upcoming content, blockers, and dependencies.

• Improve workflows and processes as we scale.



The goal isn't just to keep content moving. It's to make sure we're consistently producing the right content, at the right quality, for the right audience.



𝗬𝗢𝗨'𝗟𝗟 𝗧𝗛𝗥𝗜𝗩𝗘 𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗘 𝗜𝗙 𝗬𝗢𝗨…



• Study social media rather than just consume it. You naturally notice patterns, trends, hooks, and creative techniques.

• Have strong creative instincts. You can recognise great content and explain exactly what makes it work.

• Are obsessed with improvement. You're rarely satisfied with "good enough" when there's an opportunity to make something better.

• Think like a strategist. You connect individual content decisions to broader audience and business goals.

• Love experimenting. You bring ideas, challenge assumptions, and want the freedom to test new approaches.

• Are analytical and curious. You enjoy understanding why something worked rather than simply celebrating the numbers.

• Take ownership. You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs improving.

• Can lead through creative judgment. You give thoughtful, specific feedback that helps others produce better work.

• Are highly organised. You can balance strategic thinking with the practical realities of running a content operation.



Most importantly, you have opinions about content, can explain the reasoning behind them, and are willing to test whether you're right.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗦𝗨𝗖𝗖𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘



𝗜𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬–𝟵𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀:



• Understand our audience, platforms, content, and existing workflows.

• Take ownership of the social calendar and publishing operation.

• Identify our strongest and weakest content patterns.

• Recommend improvements to hooks, formats, storytelling, and platform strategy.

• Introduce structured content experiments.

• Start reducing the founders' involvement in day-to-day social decisions.



𝗕𝘆 𝟲–𝟭𝟮 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀:



• Social strategy is increasingly proactive and informed by performance data.

• Successful content patterns are documented, tested, and reused.

• Each platform has a clear, differentiated growth strategy.

• Content quality and audience growth improve through continuous experimentation.

• The creative team receives stronger briefs and more actionable feedback.

• The social function operates independently, with clear ownership and consistent execution.



𝗥𝗘𝗤𝗨𝗜𝗥𝗘𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗦



• 5+ years of experience in social media, content marketing, digital media, audience development, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience owning social media strategy, not just content execution.

• Strong understanding of social platforms, audience behaviour, and content performance.

• Excellent creative judgment across written, visual, and video content.

• Proven ability to turn performance data into strategic decisions.

• Experience developing and testing new content ideas.

• Strong English communication skills, native or near-native fluency.

• Excellent organisational and project-management skills.

• Experience working with creative teams.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, async environment.



𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗽𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿:



• Experience growing large social media accounts.

• Experience with educational, technology, media, or creator brands.

• Strong understanding of short-form video storytelling and retention.

• Experience developing content strategies for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube.

• Experience managing or mentoring social team members.

• Experience with sponsored content and brand partnerships.

• Experience using AI for content research, ideation, analysis, or workflows.



𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗪𝗘 𝗪𝗢𝗥𝗞



We're a remote-first, async-friendly team that values ownership, thoughtful experimentation, and clear communication.



We operate in two-week sprints, with defined priorities, documented decisions, and transparent workflows.



Our team uses Jira, Confluence, Google Docs, and Slack to collaborate across research, writing, design, animation, and publishing.



You'll work closely with our founders, but we don't want to dictate every decision.



We want someone who brings ideas to us, not someone who waits for us to come up with them.



We value strong reasoning, constructive feedback, independent thinking, and people who actively improve the way we work.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



This role is budgeted at market rates for the Philippines.



Please include your expected annual PHP salary or rate in your application.



𝗛𝗜𝗥𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗖𝗘𝗦𝗦



1. Application review: Resume, portfolio, and examples of relevant work.

2. Short interview: Focused on creative judgment, strategic thinking, analytical ability, and ownership.

3. Paid strategy exercise: Using realistic content and performance data to evaluate how you think, identify opportunities, and recommend improvements.

4. Final conversation and offer.



𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗧𝗢 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬



Please send:



1. Your resume / CV.

2. Links to social accounts or brands you've managed.

3. Two or three examples of content or campaigns you personally influenced.

4. A short response (maximum 400 words) addressing the following:



Tell us about a social account, content strategy, or content system you materially improved.



• What wasn't working, or what opportunity did you notice?

• What did your analysis or creative judgment tell you?

• What did you change, and why?

• What improved as a result?



Where possible, include specific numbers or evidence.



We're especially interested in how you think, not just what you've worked on.

title: MSP Automation Developer
description:
COMPANY



Parachute Technology is a Managed IT Service Provider. We have a friendly and supportive work environment, with a hands-on leadership. Primary headquarters is in San Ramon, CA.





We are doubling down on automation to improve client experience, reduce ticket volume, and increase technician throughput. You will design, build, and maintain automations across our PSA, RMM, and cloud platforms to streamline workflows, accelerate ticket resolution, and keep client environments compliant and well-configured at scale.





Job Description



Automation and scripting

Build and maintain reusable automations in Immybot, PowerShell/Python for Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure/Intune, and common MSP tooling.

Create event-driven workflows using APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS/RPA (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate, Zapier, Logic Apps).

Implement self-healing tasks in RMM for alert remediation, patching, software deployment, and configuration drift correction.



Workflow Optimization



Map current service workflows (incident, request, change, onboarding/offboarding) and eliminate waste via automation.

Reduce technician touch time by building triage, enrichment, and classification automations in the PSA.

Automate asset lifecycle tasks: discovery, tagging, baseline config, policy enforcement, and documentation updates.

Platform Engineering and Reliability



Own configuration hygiene across tenants (baseline policies, hardening, Intune device compliance, Conditional Access).

Create CI/CD pipelines for scripts and policy-as-code with version control, peer review, and rollback.

Add observability: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboards for automation success/fail and ROI.



Data and Integrations



Integrate PSA, RMM, documentation, and billing systems to ensure single source of truth (SSOT).

Build data pipelines to surface insights (e.g., ticket drivers, SLA risk, noisy alerts) and prioritize automation backlog.



Governance, Security, and Documentation



Follow change control, ITIL processes, and least-privilege access.

Document runbooks, code, and deployment patterns; enable technicians to safely run automations.



Impact and Success Metrics



Ticket reduction: decrease repeat/noise tickets and auto-resolve a targeted percentage of alerts/incidents.

Speed: reduce time-to-first-response and time-to-resolution for top incident categories.

Technician productivity: increase tickets closed per FTE; reduce after-hours escalations.

Configuration hygiene: increase baseline compliance (M365/Azure/Intune/RMM) and reduce drift.

Reliability: maintain automation success rate and rollback within defined SLOs.





Requirements

Required Qualifications



3+ years in an MSP or similar multi-tenant environment.

Strong scripting in PowerShell; working knowledge of Python.

Hands-on with at least one PSA (ConnectWise Manage, Autotask) and one RMM (NinjaOne, N-central, Kaseya, Datto RMM, Intune for device mgmt).

Microsoft 365/Azure AD/Entra/Intune administration and policy automation experience.

API experience: REST, JSON, OAuth; building integrations between PSA, RMM, documentation, and monitoring.

Version control (Git), code review, and basic CI/CD for scripts.

Understanding of ITIL incident/request/change practices and change risk management.

Strong documentation habits and ability to translate business requirements into technical automation.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, or other RPA/iPaaS.

Infrastructure-as-code or policy-as-code exposure (e.g., Intune templates, Graph API automation).

Monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Sentinel, Log Analytics, Splunk, Datadog).

Security automation: Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint policies, vulnerability remediation workflows.

Certifications: CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft MS-102/SC-200/MD-102, ITIL Foundation, relevant RMM/PSA certs.



Example Projects you might own:



Auto-triage: classify, enrich, and route tickets based on content, device signals, and client priority.

Self-healing: auto-restart services/processes, clear disk space, fix DNS/NTP, remediate common Windows events.

Patch orchestration: approval policies with maintenance windows and success verification.

Onboarding/offboarding: user, mailbox, license, group, device, and access automation with proof of completion.

Drift control: reconcile device and software inventories, enforce baseline configs, and update documentation automatically.

SLA risk alerts: proactive signals when SLA breaches are likely based on backlog and priority.



How You’ll Work



Collaborate with Service Desk, NOC, and Engineering to identify top automation candidates and quantify ROI.

Run discovery, design, pilot, and production rollout with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

Maintain a transparent automation backlog with business value scoring and regular stakeholder updates.

Tools you may use here

PSA: ConnectWise Manage

RMM/endpoint: ConnectWise

Microsoft 365/Azure: Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Defender, Conditional Access

Scripting and CI/CD: PowerShell, Python, GitHub/GitLab, Azure DevOps, REWST, Immybot

RPA/iPaaS: Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Zapier/Make

Monitoring/Logs: Sentinel, Log Analytics, vendor-native tools

title: Australian Property Manager/BDM
description:
Australian Property Manager / Business Development Manager (BDM) – Remote



Company: ALTO Real Estate

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: Minimum 2 years in Australian Property Management / BDM



About Us



ALTO Real Estate is a growing real estate agency based in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.



We are looking for an experienced, proactive and motivated Property Manager / Business Development Manager (BDM) to join our team remotely.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to be more than just a virtual assistant. We are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership of their responsibilities, contribute ideas, help grow our property management portfolio and grow alongside the business.



Key Responsibilities



Property Management



* Manage day-to-day communication with landlords, tenants and prospective tenants.

* Respond to enquiries, coordinate maintenance and follow up on outstanding matters.

* Assist with lease renewals, rental applications, arrears management and general property management administration.

* Maintain accurate property records and update our CRM.

* Deliver professional, prompt and friendly customer service.



Business Development & Growth



* Actively prospect for new property management clients through cold calling, follow-ups,
s and other lead generation strategies.

* Identify landlords and investors who may benefit from our property management services.

* Build relationships with prospective clients and nurture leads.

* Book qualified appraisal and management appointments.

* Follow up on enquiries and convert opportunities into new managements.

* Proactively suggest and implement new strategies to grow our rent roll.



What We’re Looking For



Essential Requirements



* Minimum 2 years of experience working in Australian Property Management and/or BDM.

* Strong understanding of Australian residential property management practices.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confident communicating with Australian landlords, tenants and prospective clients.

* Comfortable with cold calling, lead generation and sales conversations.

* Highly organised, reliable and capable of working independently.

* Proactive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.

* A genuine desire to contribute to the growth of the business.



Highly Regarded



* Previous experience working with Queensland property management legislation and processes.

* Experience using PropertyMe or other Australian property management software.

* Proven experience generating new property management business.

* Experience managing landlord relationships and handling difficult tenancy matters.



What We Offer



* Competitive salary based on experience and capability.

* Performance-based bonuses and incentives for successful new business generated.

* Long-term, stable employment with a growing Australian real estate agency.

* Opportunity for career progression and increased responsibilities.

* Supportive team environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.

* Opportunity to play a meaningful role in growing our property management division.



We believe in rewarding team members who take initiative, deliver results and help grow the business.



How to Apply



Please submit your application with the following:



1. Your resume outlining your Australian property management and BDM experience.

2. Details of which Australian states you have worked in, particularly Queensland.

3. The property management software and CRM systems you have used.

4. A brief description of your experience prospecting for new managements or generating leads.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

6. A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for this role.



Please use the subject line: “ALTO PM/BDM Application – [Your Name]”



We are looking for someone who is ambitious, accountable and excited to build a long-term career with us.



If you are someone who takes initiative, enjoys speaking with people and wants to be rewarded for helping a business grow, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are a regional company with a team of approximately 40 employees across Singapore, Korea, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our business operates across multiple markets, with teams supporting various business and operational functions.



We are looking for a proactive and independent Talent Acquisition Specialist who can manage regional recruitment while developing and improving efficient recruitment processes and systems.



This role will report directly to the CEO.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Regional Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

- Manage end-to-end recruitment across Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines, including job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, initial interviews, interview coordination, and offer follow-ups.

- Coordinate with hiring managers across different countries to understand staffing needs, job requirements, and hiring priorities.

- Identify and utilize suitable recruitment platforms and sourcing strategies for each market.

- Manage multiple vacancies simultaneously and ensure timely candidate follow-ups throughout the hiring process.

- Conduct initial candidate interviews and provide recommendations to hiring managers based on candidate suitability.

- Coordinate job offers and onboarding handovers with the HR team.



2. Recruitment Process & System Improvement

- Independently design, implement, and continuously improve recruitment processes and workflows across regional teams.

- Develop and maintain centralized recruitment tracking systems and candidate databases using Google Sheets, Google Forms, ATS, or other suitable tools.

- Standardize recruitment workflows, including screening questionnaires, interview evaluation forms, hiring stages, and approval processes.

- Build and maintain a searchable database of previous applicants for future recruitment needs.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive recruitment tasks and improve hiring efficiency.

- Develop recruitment SOPs, templates, and guidelines to ensure consistent recruitment practices across different countries.



3. Recruitment Reporting & Coordination

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment pipelines across all active vacancies.

- Prepare weekly recruitment reports, including hiring progress, candidate pipelines, recruitment KPIs, and outstanding actions.

- Monitor recruitment performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements.

- Follow up with hiring managers to ensure timely feedback and hiring decisions.

- Support other recruitment-related administrative duties as required.





Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree, Advanced Diploma, or Diploma in Human Resource Management, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

- 3–5 years of proven experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment, preferably supporting multiple vacancies and international teams.

- Experience recruiting across Singapore, Malaysia or other international markets is highly preferred.

- Proven ability to independently manage recruitment processes, from sourcing to offer coordination.

- Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, including formulas, tracking systems, candidate databases, and reporting.

- Proficient with Google Workspace tools (Docs, Forms, Calendar, Gmail, and Chat).

- Experience using recruitment platforms such as JobStreet, LinkedIn, OnlineJobs.ph, and other job portals.

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.





Preferred:

- Experience independently developing or improving recruitment workflows, tracking systems, or ATS implementation.

- Familiarity with recruitment automation tools such as Google Apps Script, Zapier, or Make.

- Experience recruiting for retail, FMCG, e-commerce, distribution, or operational roles.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and deadlines.

- Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership, and proactively recommend improvements.

- Experience working with international teams and hiring managers.

- High level of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism when handling candidate information.





Benefits:

- Structured salary increase and promotion based on performance.

- Leave benefits and public holidays.

title: Social media manager/ content creator
description:
Social Media Manager / Content Creator – Aesthetics Brand



We’re looking for a creative, organised Social Media Manager to take over the day-to-day content management for an established aesthetics clinic. (exult cosmetics Ltd).



Our current social media team has worked with us for several years, so we already have a strong understanding of our brand, messaging, audience and the types of content that perform well. We’re now looking for someone new who can take what is already working, maintain that consistency, but also bring fresh creative ideas to the table.



What the role involves



You’ll be responsible for:



- Creating approximately 6 social media posts/reels per week

- Creating and posting regular Instagram/Facebook Stories

- Taking the photos, videos, before-and-afters and other content we provide and turning them into finished social media content

- Editing and creating Reels from footage supplied by us

- Writing/adapting captions and hooks in our existing tone of voice

- Scheduling/posting content across - Instagram,
 and ideally 

- Repurposing appropriate content across the different platforms

- Reviewing what content is performing well and using that information to guide future content (aesthetics related)

- Looking at trends and bringing us new creative content ideas

- Maintaining a consistent, premium visual identity across the brand

- Planning and organising content in advance



We currently use Asana to manage content and would ideally like to continue using it and that way you can see the current work, although we’re open to another system if you already have a good workflow.



 Content is provided



You will not be expected to come into the clinic and film everything yourself.



We already provide photos, treatment footage, before-and-afters, talking videos and other raw content through a shared content library.



Your job is to take that content and turn it into the finished posts, Reels and Stories for the week.



What you WON’T be responsible for



This isn't a DM, sales or customer service role.



We already have somebody managing:



- Instagram/Facebook 

- Lead follow-up

- Sales conversations

- Appointment enquiries



Your focus is purely content creation, social media management and posting.



Who we're looking for



Ideally, you’ll already have experience working with:



- Aesthetic clinics

- Med spas

- Beauty brands

- Cosmetic clinics

- Skin clinics

- Health/wellness brands

- Similar female-focused premium service businesses



A good understanding of the aesthetics industry would be a huge advantage because you'll already understand treatments, terminology, the client demographic and the type of content that resonates with our audience.



You should also be someone who is graphically creative and doesn't simply wait for us to tell you exactly what to create.



We want someone who can look at our existing brand and say:



"I can see what's working here, but I've also got some ideas of how we could make this even better."



 The ideal person



You’re:



- Creative

- Reliable

- Very organised

- Strong at Reels/video editing

- Good at Canva/graphic design

- Comfortable analysing social performance

- Able to follow an established brand style

- Confident bringing your own ideas

- Familiar with Instagram trends

- Experienced in managing an ongoing content calendar



There are no set working hours.



We're much more interested in the work being consistently created, approved and posted on time than somebody sitting online between certain hours.



This would suit a freelancer, experienced social media manager or small social media agency looking for a long-term client relationship.

To apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about you

2. Examples of social media accounts you currently manage or have previously managed

3. Any aesthetics, med spa, beauty or health brands you've worked with

4. Examples of Reels/content you've personally created

5. Your monthly fee for managing the above

6. What you would personally change, improve or introduce to an established aesthetics social media account



Please don't send a generic social media management proposal. We'd really like to see your actual work and understand your creative style.

title: AI UGC Creator
description:
Do you love putting together ideas or concepts using AI in the most realistic way? Are you passionate about AI creating and want to ascend to the highest level? Do you feel excited and driven when you get to create new AI content? We are an AI content agency that's strongly committed to creating the AI content of the highest quality and realism to help reach new heights for our clients while creating the culture and environment that simply makes you better as an AI creator.



The ideal candidate will have already worked their way through the low-quality AI outputs with unrealistic background sounds and motions, knows how to operate and prompts in AI generation tools and is now ready for the next step in their journey.



You should be comfortable focusing mostly on yourself and love thinking deeply about how "real" looks like and how to get it out of AI models. You have already created viral AI videos and you know that a great video comes from great inputs. You know how to make any product look natural and authentic. You are a driven person who turns scripts into reality with AI generation tools, and you love to analyze your generations to see what you can improve.



You will get to work with passionate and driven creators who excel at what they do. You will be a part of a culture where everyone likes to help each other, gives honest feedback to each other and strives to be their best. You will make new friends, have fun, and be around people who are serious about what they do. You will get to learn from courses, videos, and other sources that will help you grow and improve your AI creation and how to apply it to your content the best way.



What we do



- We create and turn organic AI content ideas into videos, for social media platforms that helps brands increase their revenue

- Our agency is a team full of passionate and driven AI creators who work together side by side and like to be challenged

- We create a friendly and competitive culture where each of us can individually grow and have fun

- Education is very important to us, so we help creators on how to constantly improve in content and AI creation

- We believe in every member of our team and make it the highest priority to ensure everyone has what they need to make their content successful

- we break down content and provide honest feedback to make each of us learn, improve and grow



Who we are looking for



- A content creator with a deep understanding of AI content creation and a strong feel for realism

- An individual who is driven, competitive, and passionate about AI content

- Someone who loves to turn scripts and ideas into finished videos with AI on a continual basis



Your role



- You will generate realistic images based on the idea/concept given to you and turn them together with script into clips with Veo Omni, Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 or other up-to-date video models

- You will work with reference images and starting/ending frames and write prompts that tell the model exactly what to do

- You will create voiceovers in ElevenLabs or other apps with similar functioning when the video needs them

- You will do simple editing by connecting all your generations together, cutting out the silences, and adding captivating add-ons, captions and headlines to finalize your video for posting

- You will take part in meetings where your content will be reviewed, and you will receive direct feedback

- You will analyze your generations and your metrics in order to keep your content realistic, unique and attractive



Things that should resonate with you



- You already have a great amount of experience with creating AI content on a daily basis

- You have already generated a significant amount of views with content created by AI

- When you watch an AI video, you can instantly tell what breaks the realism and how to fix it



What we expect from you



- You have a deep understanding of AI realism. You know how "real" looks like, how physics behaves on camera, and you apply it directly to your generations

- Image generation is very close to you. You know how to generate authentic and realistic images with Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2.0, Seedream, or other up-to-date image models

- You have already generated AI UGC content with Omni, Kling 3.0, and Seedance 2.5. You possess high level prompting skills and understand video generation to its core

- You know that the quality of the output is d
 by the quality of the inputs, and you take your time with references, frames and prompts

- You can edit your generations into a flawless final video from start to end

- You take ownership of your work, and you are not afraid of new challenges

- You love learning new things, and you have a strong desire to prove yourself you can be even better at what you do

- You speak English fluently, and you use it and understand it at a high level



We are here to push the limits with organic AI content while helping clients reach new heights. Everyone here is serious and loves to create content with AI. We respect each other, help each other, and grow together while having fun in the process. There are no egoistic people here, only humble ones. If you are not passionate and driven about the same things, then this job is not for you.



If you feel like this deeply resonates with you and you are ready to make a long-term change in your life, please send us your resumé and a cover letter in which we want you to tell us why you should be the one for this position and your accomplishments. If you can show them to us, then that's a plus. Send us your application and we will get in touch with you and tell you what is next.

title: Full-Time Inbound Sales & Booking VA for Cleaning Company

Work all unbooked leads through our follow-up cadence (multiple calls & texts over several days).

Confirm details with customers and keep notes accurate in our CRM.

Invite one-time customers to become recurring clients and record those correctly.

Outbound Sales.

Handle simple

REQUIREMENTS

Excellent spoken & written English.

Stable internet, good headset, quiet workspace.

Experience in phone-based customer service or sales is a big plus.

Comfortable making many calls and following a script.

Reliable, detail-oriented, okay with repetitive work (this is how you earn more).

Experience with GHL preferred (Not required)

Fixed base hourly rate (paid in USD, full-time).

$ Bonus per completed job you book.

+ more incentives to be put in place



HOW TO APPLY:

First line must start with:

"I actually read everything – [Your First Name] – 7 + 5 = ?"

Paste a link to a 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself.

Paste your internet speed test link..
