title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US



We're a fast-growing Australian company working across the fashion, retail and beauty industries. Our fully remote team has grown from around 30 to almost 50 people in the past year, and we're still growing.



Our Filipino team members are employed through our Philippine company, with full local benefits.



OUR CULTURE



We're a positive, supportive team that genuinely cares about its people. Our values are integrity, compassion, resilience, trust and exceptional delivery, and we hire people who live them. You'll be treated as a valued member of the team, not just a remote worker, with founders who back you, recognise good work and want you to grow with the business.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're hiring our first dedicated Talent Acquisition Specialist to own hiring for our growing team, from approved job brief through to accepted offer. This is a fully remote, work-from-home role. You'll work closely with our HR Business Partner, who looks after every new team member from onboarding onward.



You'll also work directly with the founders. This is a great opportunity for an experienced recruiter who wants real ownership, visibility and a direct hand in building a business. The founders are busy, so you'll need to run your work autonomously, make sound calls without being chased, and manage up: flag risks early, push for decisions and keep them informed without waiting to be asked.



Excellent written and spoken communication is key. You'll be the first point of contact for every candidate and a daily voice to the founders, so clear, confident and professional English is essential.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Run several hiring processes at once, targeting 3–7 successful hires per month

- Write clear, compelling job ads and post them across OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, JobStreet and SEEK

- Track ad results and improve titles, copy, screening questions and channels when results fall short

- Proactively source passive candidates rather than waiting for applications

- Screen applicants and run first-round interviews covering skills, communication, motivation and fit

- Present a qualified shortlist within 7 business days, explaining why each candidate fits and flagging any concerns

- Coordinate final interviews, reference checks and offers

- Keep every candidate informed, including timely closure for unsuccessful applicants

- Hand over each new hire to our HR Business Partner, and review past hires together to sharpen future hiring

- Report weekly to the founders on open roles, pipeline, ad performance and expected hires

- Use AI tools to work faster, while keeping judgement and candidate communication human



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written and spoken English – this is essential

- Proven experience independently managing multiple hiring processes at the same time

- Hands-on experience with OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, JobStreet and/or SEEK, including paid ads and active sourcing

- A confident interviewer with sound judgement of capability and fit

- Comfort using data to change your approach

- Practical, everyday use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude

- Self-driven and able to work autonomously, with the confidence to manage up to senior leaders

- Highly organised, proactive and able to keep momentum without close supervision

- A reliable home setup with a quiet workspace and stable internet

- Discretion with confidential information

- Bonus: experience recruiting Filipino talent for Australian companies, or retail and fashion industry experience



WHAT YOU'LL GET



- US$250 per week base pay

- US$50 for every successful hire – at 3–7 hires a month, that's an extra US$150–350 monthly

- Employment through our Philippine company, with SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month pay and HMO health cover

- Paid leave

- A fully remote, work-from-home role

- A positive, supportive team culture

- A long-term role working directly with the founders of a fast-growing business



HOW TO APPLY



Attention to detail matters in this role. Start your application with the words "Talent First", then answer these two questions:



1. Which platforms have you recruited on, and roughly how many hires did you make in the last 12 months?

2. In under 150 words, tell us about the hardest role you've filled: what it was, how you found the candidate and how long it took.



Please attach your CV. Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.

title: Meta Ads Compliance Specialist
description:
Become the person who keeps our clients’ Meta ads compliant and their accounts healthy.



$1,000/month | Full-time | Fully remote | European business hours



About us



Bielby Group is a Finland-based company that builds and runs businesses in advertising, payments and customer lifecycle, serving 500+ customers worldwide with more than $100M in yearly ad spend and $70M+ in yearly card spend. We’re a lean, fast-growing remote team that values ownership, accuracy and getting things done.



The role



Our clients spend millions on Meta ads every month, and their results depend on their ad accounts staying healthy. Meta’s enforcement is stricter than ever: rejected ads and policy violations can quickly lead to restricted accounts and lost revenue. Today our compliance mostly reacts after Meta flags something. We want to change that.



You’ll be the person who finds problems before Meta does. You’ll approve new clients’ websites, audit live accounts, track spend and account health, and work directly with clients to fix issues quickly. This role is for someone who’s obsessed with detail, comfortable having clear conversations with clients, always learning, and who uses AI to work faster and more accurately.



What you’ll do



● Review new clients’ websites and landing pages against Meta’s Advertising Standards and our compliance rules, and give a clear approved or rejected decision with the exact fixes needed

● Handle approval requests from clients and partners quickly, so onboarding never waits on compliance

● Audit live ads, creatives, copy and landing pages regularly, not only when Meta sends a rejection

● Respond the same day to Meta ad rejections: swap non-compliant ads for compliant versions, pause them and tell the client

● Apply our tiered process: 24 hours to fix minor issues, ads off immediately for serious breaches, and offboarding for products that can’t run on Meta

● Explain issues to clients clearly and politely in their Slack channels, with their Account Manager in copy

● Produce daily spend reports across all client accounts and flag which clients are growing, slowing down or have stopped spending

● Watch rejection rates and account-health signals, and alert the team to accounts at risk before they’re restricted

● Keep an accurate record of every finding, action and follow-up

● Follow Meta policy updates and turn them into updates to our rules, SOPs and client guidance

● Use AI tools every day to review pages and creatives, draft compliant copy and speed up checks and reports, and always verify the output yourself

● Suggest automations and better tools, so we can check more accounts with less manual work



About you



● 1+ years of hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager (media buying, agency, ad ops, or policy or compliance work)

● Solid working knowledge of Meta’s Advertising Standards, especially health and supplements, personal attributes, misleading claims and landing page requirements

● Obsessed with detail: you notice the small claim, the hidden redirect or the “before and after” image that others miss

● Confident with numbers and spreadsheets

● Clear, confident written English, and comfortable telling a client something they don’t want to hear

● You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly in your work and want to find new ways to use them

● Hungry to learn and stay ahead of policy changes

● You take ownership, close the loop on every finding and flag uncertainty instead of guessing

● Reliable availability during European business hours, with a stable internet connection and backup power



It’s a bonus if you have:



● Experience with e-commerce, DTC, nutra/supplements or other closely reviewed verticals

● Experience at an agency, ad-tech or performance marketing company

● Knowledge of TikTok or Google ad policies

● Experience with Slack, ClickUp, Google Sheets or automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n)

● Experience building checklists, SOPs or AI workflows for review work



What we offer



● $1,000 per month*

● Full-time

● Fully remote, work from anywhere

● Aligned with European business hours

● Room to grow with the business



*This is a gross monthly fee for an independent contractor. You're responsible for tax in your country of residence. Please apply only if you're happy to work remotely on this basis.

title: Outreach Coordinator — Creator & Community Outreach
description:
Company: MailDay  

Type: Part-time, deliverable-based  

Compensation: $350 USD/month + performance bonuses  

Schedule: Flexible, Monday–Friday deliverables  

Growth Opportunity: Partnerships & Business Development



About MailDay



MailDay is a U.S.-based children's pen-pal membership for ages 4–12. We match kids with real pen pals, send monthly story-driven letter missions, and bring back the excitement of sending and receiving real mail.



Website: 



We're a small, founder-led business looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Outreach Coordinator to help introduce MailDay to more families.



Our immediate priority is simple: get MailDay in front of more of the right people.



We already have AI prospecting systems, outreach templates, and an organized CRM. We need someone who can take those resources and consistently turn them into thoughtful, personalized outreach.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We're looking for someone who writes well, pays attention to details, and can work independently without needing constant direction.



Pay



$350 USD per month, paid monthly.



Plus a company growth bonus:



- $150 bonus in any calendar month MailDay gains 20–39 new paying members.

- $300 bonus in any calendar month MailDay gains 40 or more new paying members.



Bonuses are based on MailDay's total new paying memberships, not individual
 attribution. Bonuses are not cumulative.



This is a deliverable-based role, not an hourly position. You're responsible for completing the agreed-upon work, not logging a certain number of hours.



You choose when to work, provided the work is completed consistently, deadlines are met, and communication is reliable.



If you finish your day's work in two hours, your day is done.



We anticipate approximately 15–20 hours per week, depending on your experience and efficiency.



What You'll Deliver:



Every Working Day (Monday–Friday)



1. Homeschool Co-op Outreach



- Send 20 personalized outreach
s to homeschool co-ops and relevant organizations.

- Use our approved outreach templates, adapting each message to the specific recipient.

- Verify contact information and relevant details before sending.

- Accurately log all outreach in ClickUp.



2. Creator Outreach



- Prepare 20 personalized outreach messages for homeschool, parenting, and family-focused content creators.

- Review each creator's content and identify a genuine, specific personalization opportunity.

- Adapt our approved templates to sound natural and relevant.

- Prepare messages for founder sending or send through approved channels when authorized.



3. Replies & Follow-Ups



- Check incoming outreach replies.

- Complete all scheduled follow-ups.

- Respond to routine questions using approved messaging.

- Identify interested creators and organizations and keep those conversations moving.

- Flag promising opportunities or questions requiring founder attention.



4. ClickUp & Daily Reporting



- Update every outreach record with the correct status, contact method, and follow-up information.

- Ensure interested prospects have a clear next step.

- Submit a short, three-line daily report covering:

  - Outreach completed.

  - Replies and interested contacts.

  - Questions, blockers, or anything requiring attention.



Every Week



 Group Admin Outreach



- Review relevant
 groups identified by our AI prospecting system.

- Identify the appropriate administrator or decision-maker.

- Review the group's rules, audience, and recent activity.

- Draft 15 personalized messages to group administrators proposing a relevant MailDay collaboration or community feature.

- Prepare messages for founder approval and sending.

- Track outreach and responses in ClickUp.



Pipeline Management



- Review AI-sourced creator, co-op, and community prospects before outreach.

- Verify accuracy, relevance, and contact information.

- Flag duplicates, incomplete records, and unsuitable prospects.

- Keep the outreach pipeline organized and ready for the following week.

- Ensure interested contacts receive appropriate follow-ups.



What Counts as Completed Work?



We care about quality, not simply checking boxes.



A completed outreach message must:



- Be directed to a relevant, qualified recipient.

- Include accurate, specific personalization.

- Follow our approved brand voice and messaging guidelines.

- Be ready to send without significant rewriting.

- Be accurately documented in ClickUp.



Generic AI-generated personalization, duplicate outreach, incorrect contact information, and incomplete CRM records do not count as completed deliverables.



We encourage using AI to work efficiently, but you MUST verify its output. Copying and pasting AI-generated information without checking it is not acceptable.



If a prospect list doesn't contain enough qualified contacts to meet a daily target, communicate that promptly rather than sending unsuitable outreach.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- Excellent written English, particularly natural and conversational messaging.

- Experience with
 outreach, creator outreach, lead generation, or similar work.

- Strong attention to detail and research verification skills.

- Ability to follow established processes independently.

- Comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

- Strong organizational skills and consistent follow-through.

- Proactive communication and willingness to ask questions when something is unclear.

- Reliable internet access.



Preferred but not required:



- Experience with ClickUp or similar CRM software.

- Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, and
 communities.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

- Interest in homeschooling, parenting, children's education, or family-focused brands.



How We Work



We're a small team, and we value people who take ownership of their responsibilities.



You'll receive access to our established systems, messaging templates, and instructions.



We don't expect perfection on day one, but we do expect you to learn from feedback, catch mistakes before submitting work, and communicate proactively.



You won't be responsible for building prospect lists from scratch, managing paid advertising, creating social media content, or designing marketing materials.



Your job is to make our existing outreach process work consistently and effectively.



Opportunity to Grow



As MailDay grows, this position may expand into a larger Partnerships & Business Development role.



Future responsibilities could include managing creator affiliates, coordinating brand collaborations, developing community partnerships, and overseeing partnership onboarding.



For now, our focus is on excellent outreach execution.



We're looking for someone interested in growing with the company as opportunities develop.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction and your relevant outreach experience.

2. An example of a personalized outreach
 or DM you've written.

3. The AI tools and CRM platforms you've used.

4. Confirmation that you're comfortable with the deliverables.



Please also complete this short writing exercise:



Imagine you're reaching out to a homeschooling mom on Instagram who shares activities and educational resources for her young children.



Write a short, friendly DM introducing MailDay and asking whether she'd be interested in learning about a potential collaboration.



We want to see how you naturally communicate. Please don't send a long, formal sales pitch.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical assessment before receiving ongoing assignments.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (Full-Time | Canva + Adobe + AI Workflow | Hands-On Senior Role)
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Graphic Designer (Full-Time | Canva + Adobe + AI Workflow | Hands-On Senior Role)



SHIFT: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday - Friday (8:00 PM - 4:00 AM PHT or 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM PHT depending on Daylight Saving Time). Note: The 8:00 AM Eastern clock-in is strict.

HOURS: 40 Hours per Week (Full-Time, Long-Term)

COMPENSATION: $700 USD per Month (Bi-weekly or monthly direct payout, no unpaid test work required to apply)



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT THE ROLE & OUR CULTURE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for an experienced, highly adaptable Senior Graphic Designer to take full ownership of our visual creative execution across both digital and print.



In this role, you will set the visual bar for our accounts, ensure uncompromising brand consistency, catch technical errors before clients ever see them, and personally produce polished assets for our clients.



No Creepy Surveillance: We believe in professional autonomy. We do not use time-tracking screenshots, keyloggers, or webcam monitoring. Our culture runs on trust, clear deliverables, and milestone accountability. In exchange for that independence, we demand strict punctuality at our 8:00 AM Eastern start, fast responsiveness on chat during your shift, and total ownership over deadlines.



CRITICAL: STRICTLY INDIVIDUAL FREELANCERS ONLY

Do not apply if you run an agency, subcontract tasks, or employ other people to do your work. We are hiring one dedicated, full-time team member. You will personally join daily English voice or video calls, participate in live design reviews, and execute the actual creative deliverables yourself.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL DO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- High-Standard Hands-On Design (70%): Execute polished, conversion-focused digital assets (social campaigns, paid ads, presentation decks, marketing collateral) and production-ready print materials (menus, brochures, flyers, large-format banners).

- Prepress & Technical File Preparation: Take complete ownership of production files. Ensure correct CMYK color spaces, bleed margins, vector scaling, and font licensing before anything goes to print or live deployment.

- Brand Consistency & Quality Control (15%): Audit graphics across agency accounts, spot alignment or typographic errors before client delivery, and establish reusable design systems that keep client assets consistent.

- AI-Driven Workflows: Integrate modern AI tools into daily production. Use Claude (Claude Design) for building brand guides and rapid web layout prototyping, along with ChatGPT and Gemini for visual ideation, concept testing, and mood boarding before finalizing assets in Adobe or Canva.

- Tool Agility: Rely on Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for complex photo manipulation, vector illustration, and prepress work, while happily using Canva for rapid asset iteration, team templates, and fast client handoffs.

- Technical & Web Collaboration (15%): Assist with visual and layout prep for landing pages, web graphics, and CMS platforms (working knowledge of WordPress, Elementor, or Figma layout principles is a major asset).



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- Deep Visual & Technical Foundation: You have mastered typography, visual hierarchy, spacing, and color theory. You catch a 2-pixel misalignment or an unlinked font without being told.

- Autonomous Problem Solver: If a brief lacks clear direction, you do not sit idle. You review existing brand history, propose two strong creative directions, and present solutions.

- Adaptable & Coachable: You handle direct client critique with composure and pivot quickly without taking feedback personally.

- Strong English Communicator: You can clearly articulate design choices, ask clarifying questions early, and participate in brief daily design check-ins comfortably on call.

- Robust Workstation & Redundancy: You run a powerful computer capable of handling multi-layer PSDs and heavy vector files without lagging, backed by stable fiber internet and a reliable power/data fallback plan.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

REQUIREMENTS

---------------------------------------------------------------
+ years of proven professional experience as a Senior Graphic Designer.

- Expert-level mastery of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.

- Solid, practical proficiency with Canva for rapid template creation and fast delivery.

- Comprehensive technical knowledge of prepress standards (bleed, slug, safe zones, 300 DPI resolution, CMYK separation) and digital standards (aspect ratios, compression, retina displays).

- Active, daily hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Adobe Firefly).

- Fluent verbal and written English communication for daily voice/video meetings.

- Must apply as an individual contributor committed solely to our team during shift hours.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NICE-TO-HAVE (BONUS POINTS)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- Hands-on experience designing or updating pages in WordPress using Elementor.

- Experience with Figma for UI mockups, responsive wireframes, or design component handoffs.

- Experience establishing reusable design systems and file hygiene guidelines.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(Applications that do not include a working portfolio link or fail to answer the questions below will be filtered out immediately.)



Send your application with the Subject Line:

"Senior Designer - [Your First Name] - [Your Favorite Design Tool]"



Please include your direct answers to the following in your message:



1. Portfolio Link: Provide a direct link to your portfolio (Behance, personal website, Drive, or PDF). Your portfolio MUST showcase both commercial Print work (flyers, menus, brochures) and Digital/Web creative. Ensure permissions are set to public.



2. Quality Control & File Prepress: You receive a 3-page tri-fold brochure intended for commercial offset printing. What are 3 specific technical errors you check for before approving the file for the print vendor?



3. The Adobe vs. Canva Dynamic: Some senior designers consider Canva below their skill level. What is your perspective on utilizing Canva inside a fast-paced agency alongside Photoshop and Illustrator?



4. AI in Your Real Workflow: We utilize Claude (Claude Design) for structured branding guides and web layout prototyping, alongside ChatGPT and Gemini for visual ideation. Describe a specific recent project where you used an AI tool to accelerate your creative process, and how you took that AI output to a finished, client-ready state.



5. Technical & Web Experience: Briefly describe your experience (if any) with WordPress, Elementor, or Figma. If you have ever prepared visual assets specifically for an Elementor website build, what rules did you follow to ensure fast web performance?



6. Shift & Terms Confirmation: Confirm that you are applying as a solo individual (no agency or outsourced team), that you are fully available for the strict 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Eastern Time shift (including daily spoken calls in English), and that you accept the flat rate of $700 USD per month.



7. Hardware & Redundancy: List your computer specifications (RAM, CPU, GPU) and detail your backup setup if your main internet provider experiences downtime during your working shift.

title: Loan Processor
description:
Loan Processor Job Description



• Conduct detailed serviceability checks to confirm applicants can meet repayment obligations, using relevant calculators and tools.

• Check loan scenarios against individual lender credit policies to confirm eligibility and identify potential issues before proceeding.

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

• Evaluate the financial position of loan applicants to determine borrowing capacity, analysing income, expenses, and existing debt obligations.

• Collect all required documents from loan applicants, including income statements, credit reports, and identification documents, and verify their authenticity and completeness.

• Prepare loan proposals presenting suitable lender options based on the client's situation and lender policies, and ensure all proposals are reviewed with the broker.

• Ensure all documents are accurate, complete, and meet lender requirements prior to lodgement.

• Input client and loan data accurately into CRM systems and submit applications to lenders via the appropriate online portals.

• Act as the central point of contact for brokers, clients, and lenders throughout the application process, providing timely progress updates and addressing queries accurately.

• Follow up with lenders and/or clients via phone or email for updates and outstanding requirements.

• Coordinate with underwriters, brokers, and internal tea
mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

• Continuously develop and maintain knowledge of lender policies, products, and credit criteria through training and self-study.

• Follow up all cases from formal approval through to settlement, including checking loan documents upon issuance and following up on outstanding settlement conditions.

• Ensure the outgoing financier (OFI) is ready for settlement where applicable (refinances).

• Advise clients on funds required to complete settlement, and liaise with all relevant parties — solicitors, lenders, and agents — to ensure files are ready.

• Notify clients once settlement is booked, send settlement breakdowns, and complete the settlement checklist in the system.

• Set up post-settlement action plans and support clients with ongoing loan maintenance enquiries and requests.

• Follow up with clients every six months, handle loan change requests, and apply and confirm cash rebates.

• Conduct birthday and annual reviews, including follow-up on fixed rate expiries.

• Manage construction progress drawdowns: collect and follow up on construction document checklists, follow up on commencement letters, and track construction progress through to completion.



Qualifications:

• Minimum 2–3 years of Australian mortgage broking or lending experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Australian Mortgage CRM platforms (e.g., Mercury, MyCRM, Salestrekker, Flex)

• Strong understanding of lender credit policies, serviceability requirements, and loan structures.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document management.

• High level of written and spoken English communication skills.

• Analytical mindset with strong numeracy skills.

• Excellent problem-solving ability and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

• Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a client-first approach.

title: PunchOut Cloud Integration & Customer Support Specialist (cXML, JSON & B2B Procurement Integrations)
description:
Position overview

BuyerQuest is hiring a second PunchOut Cloud specialist. This person is an integration specialist first and a customer support person second: you configure, change and fix customers' PunchOut connections yourself instead of handing them to another team. The role is fully remote.

A customer reports that a cXML message is failing or a catalog will not open. You read the payload, list possible causes, change the configuration, retest and confirm the fix with the customer. Engineering gets a case only after you have found the cause and can show what you tried.

This is not a help-desk, guide-sharing or ticket-routing role, and it is not a software development role.



Key responsibilities

• Set up and configure PunchOut connections for customers: endpoints, credentials, identities, shared secrets and catalog settings.

• Diagnose failed PunchOut sessions, orders and invoices by reading the cXML or JSON payload, the response and the logs, then make the configuration or mapping change that fixes it.

• Edit and test mapping configuration, including find-and-replace rules that clean values before they reach a buyer's system.

• Configure and troubleshoot the connection on the merchant's Shopify, BigCommerce or Magento store.

• Work out why something is failing when there is no documentation: list hypotheses, rank them, test them in order and say what you ruled out.

• Own the customer case end to end: reply, confirm the fix with the customer and close it.

• Escalate to Engineering only with the cause you found, what you changed and tested, and a specific request.

• Keep clear ticket and CRM notes so any teammate can pick up a case.

• Route licensing and agreement questions to the right internal owner.

Hands-on technical requirements

You can do each of these yourself and have done them for real customers. We test them in the written questionnaire and in a live problem-solving session.



Hands-on technical requirements



Configure and change customer PunchOut connections yourself: endpoints, credentials, mappings and catalog settings, then test and confirm the fix.

Read, write and debug cXML, including the PunchOut setup request and response, purchase orders and invoices.

Read, write and debug JSON, and edit mapping files without breaking them.

Map JSON to cXML, handle empty values, and clean data with find-and-replace rules.

Trace a PunchOut session from the buyer’s system to the supplier catalog and back, and say where it can break.

Know how SAP Ariba, Coupa, Workday, Oracle Fusion and SAP exchange catalog, order and invoice data with suppliers.

Understand how EDI differs from cXML and JSON.

Configure and troubleshoot connections on Shopify, BigCommerce and Magento stores.

Work out unfamiliar failures on your own: list causes, rank them and test the likeliest first.

Use Postman or curl and XML and JSON validators to send and inspect requests.



Qualifications

Essential

• Hands-on experience making configuration changes for customers in a B2B integration, PunchOut, procurement or API setting.

• Working knowledge of cXML and JSON, and of at least two of Coupa, Workday, Oracle Fusion, SAP Ariba and SAP.

• Can solve unfamiliar problems on your own: form hypotheses, test them and explain the result.

• Customer-facing technical support or integration support experience, with the customer being an external business.

• Clear written English, including concise customer-facing explanations.

• Comfort with a ticketing tool and a CRM.

Preferred

• Experience configuring Shopify, BigCommerce or Magento stores.

• EDI experience.

• Experience setting up supplier catalogs or buyer-side PunchOut connections.

• Exposure to software licensing and customer agreements.

What does not qualify on its own

• Support limited to guiding customers through online guides and raising tickets for a product team.

• Development work where someone else made every configuration change, or software development with no customer-facing support.

• IT help desk, IT or security administration and desktop support.

• ERP or system administration for internal users only, with no external customers or integration work.

• Consumer e-commerce operations, product listing and
 support.

• A keyword that appears only in a skills list.

title: YouTube Gaming Video Editor - Storytelling & Gameplay (Long-Term)
description:
Hi, I run a gaming commentary channel averaging 50 million views per month, and I'm launching a second channel focused on personality-driven gaming content.



I'm looking for a talented video editor to join me long-term and help turn livestream recordings into entertaining, story-driven YouTube videos.



The content will focus on gaming challenges, testing and comparing games, discovering unusual indie games, and funny gameplay experiences.



I'm aiming for approximately 2–3 long-form videos per week, typically around 12–25 minutes long, depending on the content.



I'm specifically looking for someone who understands the storytelling and editing style of personality driven creators like Ludwig, where gameplay follows a premise with a clear goal, establishing stakes, funny moments, and storytelling through gameplay



What you'll be doing



Watching and reviewing raw livestream recordings, typically containing 1.5–3 hours of gameplay footage.



Identifying the most entertaining moments, funny reactions, challenges, and stream moments.



Turning raw gameplay into cohesive, entertaining YouTube videos with a clear narrative.



Building the story around the original premise, including the goal, obstacles, progression, etc



Editing separately recorded talking-head introductions and incorporating relevant B-roll.



Cutting unnecessary downtime while preserving natural conversations, humor, and personality.



Adding appropriate music, sound effects, zooms, simple graphics, and comedic edits.



Maintaining strong pacing and keeping viewers engaged throughout the video.



Suggesting additional narration or context when needed to make the story flow better.



Keeping editing projects organized and editable.



Storytelling is extremely important. I'm looking for someone who understands how to find and construct an entertaining story from raw gameplay, rather than simply cutting together funny moments or adding flashy effects.



The editing should feel natural and personality-driven, allowing funny situations and reactions to breathe while keeping the overall video engaging.



What I'll provide



Raw gameplay and livestream recordings



The original video concept, challenge, or objective



Separately recorded talking-head footage when appropriate



Additional narration or recorded segments when needed



Reference videos and examples of the desired editing style



Feedback and creative direction



You won't need to come up with video topics or record gameplay yourself.



However, you will be responsible for reviewing the footage and identifying the strongest way to tell the story. I won't be providing a fully timestamped list of every moment to include.



Requirements



Experience editing long-form YouTube gaming content



Strong storytelling instincts and understanding of narrative structure



Excellent English comprehension



Ability to independently review hours of gameplay and identify entertaining moments



Strong sense of comedic timing, pacing, and viewer engagement



Familiarity with gaming, streamers, and internet culture



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro preferred



Ability to incorporate gameplay, facecam, B-roll, and simple motion graphics



Organized project management and reliable communication



Ability to maintain consistent quality and meet agreed deadlines



Advanced motion graphics are not required. I'm much more interested in someone who understands storytelling, knows which moments to keep, and can make a video entertaining without overediting it.



Every completed video should include:



A final exported video ready for YouTube



An organized, editable project file



Upon request, a consolidated project folder containing the necessary media assets to reopen and edit the project on another computer.



This is a pay-per-video position, with the opportunity for consistent, long-term work.



The goal is to produce approximately 2–3 videos per week once we establish a reliable workflow.



Compensation will be agreed upon per video based on the amount of raw footage, expected finished length, and editing complexity.



I'm looking for someone who can work efficiently while maintaining good storytelling and editing quality.



How to apply



Please include:



Three examples of your best and most relevant long-form gaming videos, preferably involving gameplay challenges, comparisons, or personality-driven content.



Your expected rate per video in USD for a 15–20-minute finished video created from approximately 2–3 hours of raw gameplay.



Your average editing time for a project of that size, including watching and reviewing the original footage.



Your available working hours, and how many videos you can realistically complete per week.



A brief explanation of your experience turning raw gameplay into entertaining, story-driven videos.



Which editing software you use.



Please include the word cheeseburger somewhere in your application so I know you've read the entire posting.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid test edit using raw gameplay footage and references that I provide.



Long-term opportunity



I'm looking for a reliable, creative, long-term collaborator who can help build this gaming channel as it grows.



I'll provide clear video concepts, references, and feedback, but I'm also looking for someone who can bring their own storytelling instincts and creative ideas to the editing process.



There's room for increased responsibilities, consistent projects, and compensation as the channel develops.

title: Senior Cold Caller (Outbound Specialist)
description:
Senior Cold Caller (Outbound Specialist)

Arkero | Fully remote | Australian business hours



About Arkero

Arkero is an Australian recruitment firm placing skilled Philippines-based professionals with businesses across Australia and New Zealand. We specialise in four sectors: Trade & Construction, Real Estate, NDIS & Healthcare, and Accounting. As we grow, we’re looking for an experienced cold caller to lead from the front on the phones.



The role

You’ll make high-volume outbound calls to Australian and New Zealand business owners, book qualified discovery calls, and help train our BDMs to do the same. You report to our Sales Lead. This is a hands-on calling role: you’ll set the standard on the phones every day.



What you’ll do



Make high-volume outbound calls to business owners in our four sectors, from tradies to real estate principals to practice managers.

Get past gatekeepers, reach decision makers, qualify real hiring needs and book discovery calls.

Handle objections with confidence, such as “tried a VA, didn’t work” or “too busy, mate.”

Coach BDMs through call shadowing, live role-plays, call reviews and building an objection-handling library.

Help sharpen our call scripts and openers.

Log every call and next step in the CRM, and post an end-of-day report.



What success looks like



Consistently high daily call volume and conversations.

A steady flow of discovery calls booked that actually show up.

BDMs improving their call numbers and conversions.

Placements coming from the pipeline you’ve built.



What we need from you



10+ years of outbound cold calling, ideally B2B to small and medium businesses.

A proven track record with real numbers: calls per day, meetings booked, deals closed.

Experience calling Australian, NZ, UK or US businesses. Australian experience is a big plus.

Excellent spoken English, and you’re comfortable with straight-talking Aussie business owners.

Experience training or coaching other callers.

Comfortable with CRMs and cloud dialers.

A quiet workspace, quality headset, reliable internet and a backup connection.



Hours and pay

Monday to Friday, Australian business hours (AEST), fully remote. Hourly pay plus performance bonuses.



How to apply

Send all three of the following. Applications missing any of them won’t be reviewed.



Your resume, with company names and dates.

Your numbers from your most recent cold-calling role: average calls per day, conversations per day, meetings booked per week, and deals closed per month (with currency).

title: Senior Marketing Strategist — ROI & Growth Owner (Full-Time, Remote, US Org)
description:
Here’s a quick test. Read these four questions:



Is our marketing actually working?

Where are we getting real ROI — and where are we burning money?

What should we stop doing tomorrow?

Where should we invest more, and why?



If your instinct is to start answering them right now, we should talk.



Who we are

We’re the American Academy of Estate Planning Attorneys (AAEPA), a U.S.-based organization that helps attorneys grow their law firms through membership, training, and strategic education. We’re established, we’re growing, and we’re ready for a senior marketing mind to help us grow smarter.



The role

This is a full-time, remote, high-trust marketing leadership role. No one will hand you a to-do list. We’ll hand you the entire marketing operation and ask you to make sense of it — tell us what’s working, what isn’t, why, and what we do next.



What you’ll own

Audit everything we’re currently doing and separate what produces results from what just produces activity.

Stand up proper tracking so we can measure performance and ROI with confidence.

Tell us where to invest more, where to cut, and where to reallocate budget.

Dig into our CRM, contact database, lifecycle stages, funnels, and attribution.

Surface growth opportunities we’re missing.

Deliver a focused 30/60/90-day plan built around the highest-impact moves.



What you bring

Senior B2B marketing experience — CMO, marketing director, or senior marketing leader.

Fluency in the numbers: ROI, conversion rates, attribution, CAC, budgets.

Real command of CRMs, funnels,
 marketing, automation, and analytics.

The judgment to work independently, prioritize ruthlessly, and own outcomes.

Excellent written English and clear, confident communication.



Big plus if you’ve worked with membership organizations, professional associations, coaching, training, education, or other longer-sales-cycle businesses.



Please note: This is a strategy role. It is not a social media manager position and not a task-execution seat — we already have people for execution. We need someone to own the thinking.



How to apply (read this part carefully):



Skip the generic application. In your reply, give us three things:



One marketing program you audited or ran where the data changed your decision — what you found, and what you recommended.

The tools, CRMs, and analytics stacks you know best.

Your availability (hours/week) and expected rate.



Applications that cover all three go to the top of the pile. Applications that don’t, we skip.



If this sounds like you — or someone you rate highly — apply or pass it along.
